$comment: Accepted Semgrep and pnpm audit findings (tools/security-scan/README.md). Every entry: reason, owner, decision, review date (at most 366 days); a SAST entry: rule, path, at least 16 characters of the flagged line (match) and the number of findings it accepts (count, default 1). Past its review date or matching nothing, an entry fails the job `security`. A dependency vulnerability is always an accepted risk and needs the owner's decision.
